## What it is

A one-paragraph synthesis of what this project does and who it serves.
Built from README intro + entry-point inspection.

## System overview

How the pieces fit together — 1–2 paragraphs. Trace a key request from
the user's perspective through the code.

### Flow (a key user action)

```
User clicks "Upload PDF"
  → Next.js client (app/upload/page.tsx)
  → POST /api/upload  (validates + saves to S3)
  → Queue job in BullMQ
  → Worker extracts text + embeddings
  → Stores chunks in Postgres (pgvector)
  → Notifies client via SSE
```

### Deployment topology

- **Frontend**: Vercel (Next.js)
- **API**: Vercel serverless functions
- **Worker**: Railway (long-lived Node process)
- **Database**: Neon (Postgres + pgvector)
- **Object storage**: Cloudflare R2

## API surface

```
POST /api/upload         — accept PDF/PPT upload, queue ingest job
GET  /api/sessions/:id   — fetch a tutoring session by id
POST /api/chat           — stream chat with grounded context
POST /api/webhooks/clerk — sync user records from Clerk
```

## Data model

```prisma
model User { ... }
model Upload {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  ownerId   String
  status    UploadStatus
  chunks    Chunk[]
  ...
}
model Chunk { ... }
```

## External integrations

- **OpenAI** — chat + embeddings (key: `OPENAI_API_KEY`)
- **Clerk** — auth (keys: `CLERK_SECRET_KEY`, `CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`)
- **Cloudflare R2** — file storage (keys: `R2_*`)
- **Resend** — transactional email (key: `RESEND_API_KEY`)

## Background work

- **Cron** — daily quiz-rotation refresh at 02:00 UTC (`vercel.json` crons)
- **Queue** — BullMQ worker on Railway for PDF ingest

## Operations

- **CI/CD** — `.github/workflows/test.yml` runs typecheck + lint + unit tests on every PR
- **Deploys** — Vercel previews per PR; main = production
- **Error tracking** — Sentry (`@sentry/nextjs` in deps)
- **Required env vars** — see `.env.example` (11 entries)
